candidates.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
candidates.text: The glossary states that GraphicsCapability MRT and occlusion-query false positives are confirmed. At TARGET the base IGraphicsRenderer::SupportsCapability default is still permissive for the original members and DIRECTX9 inherits it wholesale, but DIRECTX9 implements MRT (bounded by NumSimultaneousRTs) and occlusion queries; which renderer, if any, still reports a false positive was not re-established.

The experimental C API release gate reports 'Not ready'. At TARGET the single unmet criterion is 'No public C++ symbol is unaccounted for' (468 public symbols unmapped), not unclassified modules as the preface says; no CI job builds the C library.

candidates.section: The linking helper makes closures explicit
candidates.text: On Windows targets CNA leaves the sharp-runtime Xml.Serialization component out of its closure (CNA_SHARP_RUNTIME_HAS_XML_SERIALIZATION OFF) and removes the math and input XmlSerializationEXTTests, so the XmlSerializationEXT surface is absent from Windows builds. The stated reason (Diagnostics' Process.cpp including <poll.h> outside its POSIX guard) was fixed in sharp-runtime next by 88c12f15 (2026-09-14), which next @ 41b918c9 contains; the CNA comment asks to remove the condition once that happens.

CNA records no sharp-runtime revision: the build adds whatever checkout sits at CNA_SHARP_RUNTIME_ROOT, CI clones branches through scripts/ci/clone_siblings.sh, and several workflows pin August 2026 sharp-runtime commits (bc8dbf41, f23ded28, df1b42ab) that lack the Resources and Xml.Serialization components CNA's closure names, so those lanes should stop at configure with 'Unknown Sharp Runtime component'.
candidates.evidence: CMakeLists.txt (CNA_SHARP_RUNTIME_ROOT); scripts/ci/clone_siblings.sh; .github/workflows/devices-tests.yml, htmldom-ci.yml, emscripten-multi-renderer-ci.yml, apple-ci.yml, metal-macos-ci.yml, content-pipeline-windows-ci.yml (sharp-runtime ref); sharp-runtime cmake/SharpRuntimeComponents.cmake (unknown component FATAL_ERROR)

candidates.text: CNA public headers Viewport.hpp, ContentManager.hpp and the Microsoft::Devices::Sensors reading headers include SharpRuntime/Prop.hpp, which defines 31 unnamespaced macros including YES, NO, nothing, ref1, static0 and getter1; SharpRuntimeHelper.hpp adds CONTAINS and INTERNAL. Any game translation unit including those headers has identifiers with those spellings rewritten by the preprocessor.

candidates.section: String and StringBuilder: static utility versus mutable buffer
candidates.text: sharp-runtime's text APIs (String, StringBuilder, Encoding counts) index and count UTF-8 bytes, not UTF-16 code units (declared permanent deviation #2015); positions and lengths differ from .NET for non-ASCII text and byte-range edits can leave ill-formed UTF-8.

candidates.section: Generic continuations exist; generic combinators do not
candidates.text: Task::WhenAll and Task::WhenAny accept only std::vector<Task>; there is no overload for std::vector<TaskT<TResult>> producing a result array or a typed winner.

sharp-runtime tasks start one std::async thread per task (no pool) and throw PlatformNotSupportedException in single-threaded Emscripten builds; threaded web builds need SHARP_RUNTIME_ENABLE_EMSCRIPTEN_THREADS (set by CNA_ENABLE_EMSCRIPTEN_THREADS).

sharp-runtime's Regex is a header-only wrapper over std::regex with the ECMAScript grammar: .NET-only syntax is translated or stripped and match timeouts cannot interrupt a running search; the component has no component test executable (integration parity tests only).

candidates.section: The measured gate is not green
candidates.text: sharp-runtime's last recorded full gate before next @ 41b918c9 (NEXT.md, 2026-09-19) lists five failing Xml.Linq namespace tests, and its CI runs only on Ubuntu; Windows, macOS and Emscripten evidence is compile-only or downstream.

candidates.text: Four sharp-runtime module directories own no component tests at 41b918c9 (io-compression-zip, security-cryptography-random, storage, text-regular-expressions); Storage is linked privately by CNA's storage module.

candidates.text: meta-gl exposes no 64-bit query-object read and no GL_GPU_DISJOINT_EXT query; CNA's EasyGLGpuTimerRenderer therefore measures GL_TIME_ELAPSED in 32-bit nanoseconds (saturates at about 4.29 s) and can reject only the all-ones value, not detect disjoint events.

Sibling hazard: easygl::ResourceRegistry::OnContextLost/OnContextRestored iterate the live resources_ vector; a release_gl_handle_only/recreate_gl_resource callback that adds or removes a registration invalidates the iteration. Whether any CNA recoverable object does so during restore was not traced.

No CNA workflow clones free-direct, so no CI job builds or tests FREEDIRECT; its 21 CTests register only with CNA_BUILD_TESTS on a non-Windows, non-Emscripten host with FREEDIRECT selected, and free-direct/free-api are not pinned.

FREEDIRECT stores SetPresentationMode but physical output is always letterboxed, and a virtual-resolution change after the first Present keeps presenting at the old physical scale; CNA's own status document says both need a free-direct change.
FREEDIRECT is verified on Linux only; CNA's plan leaves Windows and macOS parity unverified.
candidates.evidence: docs/freedirect-renderer.md (Known, permanent limitations: real Windows/macOS verification)

candidates.text: cna-city (267b79b9) reports that ClusteredForwardEffect cannot carry many punctual lights together with a texture set; at 009d40f5 the effect's header states this as a design boundary (it binds no material textures, only base colour, metallic and roughness).

living-room-simulator (2bf3f56b, built against CNA 1b3151f2) lists CNA limitations it met (one punctual light per draw, 8-bit IBL cubes, no back-face normal flip, no alpha-tested shadow casters) in its CNA_FINDINGS.md R-1..R-35; none was re-checked at 009d40f5.

StorageContainer's wildcard queries (GetFileNames/GetDirectoryNames with * and ?) have no direct test; the only storage test source has 14 definitions covering refusals, containment and the isolated-storage coupling.
The full engine has no automatic Windows build or run; only the Win32 platform harness is cross-built and run under Wine, and all MSVC lanes are manual.
GDI's cross-built examples are not registered with CTest in a cross tree; GDI's only automatic CTest route is the manual native workflow.

candidates.section: Windows II: Wine and Engagement Gates
candidates.text: The Direct2D Wine lane has no d2d1 engagement marker and every Direct2D registration bypasses the DXVK gate, so which Direct2D implementation ran is shown only by environment controls.

CnaTests links -sJSPI=1 while, as a CNA-owned executable without CNA_EMSCRIPTEN_ASYNCIFY=OFF, it also receives -sASYNCIFY=1; its comment still describes a -fwasm-exceptions root ABI. Whether the two suspension settings conflict was not established.

candidates.section: Web III: Five Renderers, Four Kinds of Evidence
candidates.text: Only HTML_DOM has an automatic browser run; SVG_DOM's browser runner has no workflow or CTest caller, CANVAS/WEBGL1/WEBGL2 have no browser harness, and WEBGL1 is built by no workflow.

Android has no workflow or preset; the only execution records are emulator runs of an earlier revision with no retained artifacts, and content loading through ContentManager inside an APK is untested.
Mobile lifecycle handling is covered only by a portable test; no device or emulator test drives background, foreground, low memory or process recreation.
iOS evidence is a device final-link and one simulator frame; no physical device run exists, and tvOS/watchOS/visionOS are refused at configure time.
No CNA code resolves an Apple application bundle's Resources directory for content; a relative content root depends on the working directory and SDL's file-open rules, untested for a launched bundle.

candidates.section: Discovery needs a controlled escape hatch
candidates.text: In cross-compiled DIRECTX9, DIRECTX11, DIRECTX12 and Direct2D trees, CnaTests carries a CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR that runs the Wine wrapper with its engagement gate disabled (CNA_D3D9_SKIP_DXVK_GATE=1, CNA_D3D11_SKIP_DXVK_GATE=1, CNA_D3D12_SKIP_VKD3D_GATE=1). The property applies to discovery and to every discovered case and CnaTests-command route (e.g. CnaInputTests), so a GoogleTest case that creates a device in such a tree is not proven to have run through DXVK or vkd3d-proton.
candidates.evidence: cmake/UnitTests.cmake (set_target_properties(CnaTests PROPERTIES CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR ...) and its comment naming CnaInputTests)

candidates.section: Proton solves a different reproducibility problem
candidates.text: The DIRECTX12 Proton lane defaults to the moving "Proton - Experimental" runtime, records no pinned identity, applies no log-token gate and forwards only the child exit status (exec python3 proton run), so a pass through it is not reproducible and does not prove vkd3d-proton served the run; the three DirectX12 Proton fixtures depend on it.

Software_XnaLineCoverage, described by CNA as a permanent exact CTest for the two line scenes, runs run-oracle-corpus-diff-software.sh, which exits non-zero only on a render failure or missing reference; a pixel difference is printed as DIFF and the test still passes.

No workflow runs the XNA oracle corpus: D3D9_XNA_Diff exists only in a DIRECTX9 MinGW tree under Wine+DXVK, Fna3d_XNA_Oracle and the line-coverage CTests are in no workflow configuration except that EasyGL_XnaLineCoverage is reachable from general-tests-ci.yml, which does not install the Pillow module xna-diff.py imports. The DIRECTX9 39/39 record has not been repeated on native Windows.

candidates.section: Can a green test go red?
candidates.text: The Direct2D mutation checker is wired only as --dry-run (anchor existence) in the manual-dispatch d3d-windows-ci.yml; the --run mode that rebuilds and requires each targeted test to fail is never automated, so no mutation is known to be killed.
No workflow configures gcov, lcov, gcovr or llvm-cov and no CMake option adds coverage instrumentation; the only line-coverage figure is a hand-recorded 2026-08-18 report for graphics-ext.

The libFuzzer/AFL-capable harnesses (cna_compiled_effect_fuzzer with CNA_FX_FUZZER_ENTRY_POINT, cna_xna_model_fuzzer, cna_xna_intermediate_fuzzer, and the C API StringView/CubeLut fuzz sources) are not CTests and no workflow runs any fuzzing campaign; only deterministic fuzz-named GoogleTests run.
candidates.evidence: cmake/Harnesses.cmake (fuzzer targets, "Not registered as a ctest"); modules/c-api/tests/fuzz/

candidates.text: The FNA value-differential harness (tools/fna-reference, cna_reference_dump, compare-fna-reference.py) is a manual workflow: not a CTest and not in CI, and its comparison is one-directional (CNA-only keys are never reported).
Recorded Vulkan, Software and DirectX11 glTF L7 golden sets and the registered WebGPU, SDL_GPU and OpenGL4 parity-fixture CTests are run by no workflow; only the EasyGL/OPENGLES3 L7 job is in CI.

No workflow or configure preset enables CNA_BUILD_INSPECTOR, so the 27 InspectorTests never compile in CI; macOS runtime behaviour is recorded by CNA as pending; the WebBridge has no automated test (see B9 P2-102).

No CNA Song route accepts Standard MIDI: SongImporter lists .mp3 .ogg .oga .qoa .flac .opus .aac .wma, the XNB Song reader probes .ogg .oga .qoa and the media library indexes .ogg .oga .mp3 .wav .flac .opus. CNA's SDL_mixer build disables FluidSynth but leaves SDLMIXER_MIDI/SDLMIXER_MIDI_TIMIDITY at their default ON, so a Timidity decoder is compiled beneath CNA with no Song mapping, instrument policy or test.
A Texture2D .cnj colorKey is exactly one RGB triple (three integers 0-255) matched exactly; there is no colour-key range, so DirectDraw-style ranged keys need game code.

CNJ colour keying replaces a keyed texel with Color(keyR, keyG, keyB, 0), keeping the key RGB instead of producing transparent black as XNA's ColorKeyEnabled processing does; drawn with the default premultiplied BlendState::AlphaBlend (One, InverseSourceAlpha) such texels would add the key colour to the destination. Needs a focused test before classification.

Sibling free-direct @934f72f (not CNA): IDirectSoundBuffer::SetPan stores and clamps the value, and applyGain computes left/right gains for mono sources and discards them ((void)left; (void)right), so no pan is audible although README reports 'PARTIAL (constant-power pan, mono sources only)'. Affects only free-direct users (CNA's FREEDIRECT renderer does not route CNA audio through it).
Sibling free-direct @934f72f: BlitFrom silently falls through for mixed 8/32-bit copies; unexercised by the two audited games.
The XNA API census (331/331 types, 3,627/3,627 members) records behavior_assessed false on every row and is a manually run script, not a CI gate; behavioural evidence exists only for named subsets.

Official-sample coverage is evidence for CNA next of 2026-09-20, not TARGET: at cna-samples 4da98a0, 87 of 153 rows complete, 49 await owner decisions, 14 are non-ports, 2 in progress (browser gates pending), Racing Game separate; no CNA workflow builds any sample.

candidates.section: Repair the current C API release gate
candidates.text: C ABI 0.29.0 release gate reads Not ready: one criterion unmet, 468 public C++ symbols unmapped (limitations-matrix criterion reports current).

The native Win32 platform backend contains no IME composition (ImmGetContext/WM_IME_COMPOSITION), XInput gamepad, drag-and-drop (WM_DROPFILES), raw input (WM_INPUT) or per-window DPI (GetDpiForWindow) handling.

Streaming audio submission is documented as safe to call from a producer thread (audio.h Doxygen of cna_dynamic_sound_effect_instance_submit_buffer: 'That is what makes this route safe to call from a producer thread while playback runs'; docs/c-api/AUDIO.md says the same), but the route resolves the instance with BorrowDynamicInstance -> GetSoundEffectInstance -> HandleRegistry::Get, which returns CNA_RESULT_THREAD for any thread other than the handle's creation thread. The float variant uses the same path. AUDIO.md's own threading section says every audio call must run on the creation thread, so the documents contradict each other and the implementation follows the stricter rule.

candidates.text: graphics_device.h permits destroying a caller-created device while resources made on it are live ('released with it'); cna_graphics_device_destroy counts no children. The resulting state of those still-registered resource handles, and whether the caller must still destroy them, is unspecified and untested (every pure-C test destroys resources first).

cna_graphics_resource_get_graphics_device answers through BorrowGameGraphicsDevice(resource.parentGame); for a resource on a caller-created device the owner token is that device's handle, not a game, so the lookup fails instead of returning the device.

The C library and its tests are exercised by no CI job or preset. The four run configurations in compatibility_matrix.json (headless, sdlrenderer, software, asan) are only rendered into COMPATIBILITY.md; no tool, preset or workflow configures them. Six of the ten release-gate criteria (real C application, installable, documentation, safety evidence, packaged dependencies, static configuration) are satisfied by file, registration or string presence, and the compatibility criterion by document currency (--check), not by compiling.
candidates.evidence: tools/c-api/check_release_gate.py (check_* functions); tools/c-api/generate_compatibility_matrix.py (configurations rendered only; --check vs --run); CMakePresets.json; .github/workflows/c-api-*.yml

candidates.text: docs/c-api/HANDLES.md documents CNA_RESULT_SHUTTING_DOWN for a closing or closed runtime (and a different-runtime handle row); no route in modules/c-api/src returns it (only ErrorCategoryForResult maps it), so a stale handle after shutdown answers CNA_RESULT_INVALID_HANDLE.

OWNERSHIP.md promises that a typed content-load handle stays valid after its manager's Unload or destruction; by reading this holds (Unload only clears the native cache), but no pure-C test uses a loaded resource after unloading or destroying its manager.

GraphicsDevice::GetMaxTextureDimension() is documented as the renderer's real maximum, but only VULKAN (maxImageDimension2D), DIRECT2D (GetMaximumBitmapSize) and GDI (SoftwareFramebufferMaxDimension) answer from a device or allocator limit; FNA3D returns the interface default explicitly and every other family inherits the constant 16384 without querying the device (for example no GL_MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE query on EasyGL/OPENGL4). GraphicsDevice::BuildRendererCapabilityProfileEXT marks RendererLimit::MaxTextureDimension as known whenever the value is non-negative, so a 'known' 16384 can exceed a real GLES device limit. The IGraphicsRenderer header comment also says no renderer overrides the method, which four do.

CNA has no counterpart of XNA 4.0's draw-time check GraphicsDevice.VerifyCanDraw, which throws InvalidOperationException (MissingVertexShaderInput) when the bound VertexDeclaration lacks a semantic the current vertex shader reads. StockEffectUsesVertexSemantic encodes the per-variant table but is used only to decide consumed streams; EasyGL, OPENGL4, SDL_GPU and WEBGPU then feed a missing secondary input from the (0, 0, 0, 1) neutral record (e.g. DualTextureEffect's TEXCOORD1 on a one-UV mesh, a texture coordinate for a textured BasicEffect on EasyGL/OpenGL4), so draws XNA refuses succeed.

candidates.text: Renderers disagree on a stock-effect draw whose declaration lacks a semantic the effect reads. WEBGPU substitutes: EnvironmentMapEffect without NORMAL0/TEXCOORD0 and non-skinned PbrEffect on a non-PBR stride fall through to a BasicEffect shape (lit/textured/coloured), and AlphaTestEffect (non-Always compare) or DualTextureEffect without TEXCOORD0 reach WebGPURenderer::DrawColoredPrimitives, which draws a stride-16 position+colour buffer untextured. SDL_GPU and WEBGPU drop BasicEffect texturing/lighting the declaration cannot feed, while EasyGL/OpenGL4 run the textured/lit program with neutral inputs.

The XNB DateTimeReader masks off and discards the two DateTimeKind bits and keeps only the 62-bit tick count, because sharp-runtime's System::DateTime does not store a kind. A DateTime written as Utc or Local loads as a plain tick value. The header documents this as a deliberate deviation.
